exposure: Mode of delivery: normal vaginal delivery, instrumental delivery, caesarean section
Perineal injury: intact perineum, episiotomy, first-degree tear, second-degree tear, third-degree tear
outcome: Sexual function as measured by the Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI)
finding: At 12 months postpartum, sexual function returned to early pregnancy levels, irrespective of mode of delivery or perineal injury.
mod_finding: There was no difference in total FSFI or domain scores according to mode of delivery over time between antenatal assessment and 12 months postpartum.
